title: Build record (record.json)
description: Everything the hub stores about one build, derived in the build's publish job (`builder record`) from the bundle files and the previous release of the branch. The hub ingests a release from build.json and this file; a part listed under `errors` is derived by the hub instead.

tag.description: The build's version tag, as in build.json `version.tag`.

previous_tag.description: The release the diff is against; null for the first build of a branch.

packages.description: The normalised package table per successful architecture, from packages.<arch>.json.gz.

layers.description: layers.<arch>.json per successful architecture, as the ci harness wrote it (bundle.schema.json `$defs/layer`, not checked again here).

tests.description: test.<arch>.json per architecture that has one, as the ci harness wrote it (test-report.schema.json, which the hub checks on ingest).

diff.description: The diff against the previous release of the branch: packages per architecture by ecosystem, config, base, sizes, the Dockerfile as a unified diff, and the classification of why the image changed.

commit.description: The repository commit of the previous release and this one, with GitHub's compare page when they differ (contracts 1.14), and the commits between them with what they touched when the build fetched the compare (contracts 1.15).

commits.description: The commits of the range, oldest first as GitHub lists them (at most 250).

bot.description: The pipeline's own commit: a [bot] account, or one of the two subjects the shared workflow writes (Update package versions, Update generated files).

count.description: GitHub's total for the range; above the commits listed when it exceeds 250.

truncated.description: GitHub listed only part of the commits or files, so `areas` may be incomplete.

areas.description: Files changed in the range per area: manifest (image.yml), dockerfile, root (root/), generated (what builder render writes), packages (package_versions.txt), other. Only areas with changes; the first three can change the image.

vulns.description: grype's findings against each architecture's syft document, one database for both.

base.description: The base image's layer digests per architecture as its registry publishes them, keyed by the index digest build.json records as `base.digest`.

errors.description: Parts that could not be derived, and why.

type.description: syft's package type (apk, deb, python, npm, dotnet...).

db_date.description: When the vulnerability database was built.
